body:
1. Buttons on tasks should have labels defined rather than displaying literal action names; same for the board's column names and anywhere else this happens in the project.
2. Text areas should fill their containers' width by default.
3. Visual alignment of elements.
4. Consistency in labeling:
5. Replace many select boxes with sliders, toggles, or other more appropriate options.
6. Change color of select boxes and other inputs: it's a drab yellowish-brown in dark mode and doesn't fit the theme.
7. Feature view should not show body of feature or its tasks unless the feature is focused; instead display its task count; example: 1 / 7 final.
8. Tasks Tab in Strategy page needs to be paginated
9. On the board, selecting an already selected task (or double-clicking) should scroll the page to its detail
10. Remove redundant headings ("Features" tab has a heading that says "Features" right below the tab)
11. Board's Task detail area is collapsible and sticks to the bottom of the page.
12. Remove Task creation from the board - only allowed in Strategy page
13. Setting for preferring panels on the left or right side of the screen (plan panel, etc)
title: General UI Polish
